name: cortex-cockpit
description: Harness cockpit for Claude Code: context health against the Stop guard's thresholds, Cortex memory health and grooming, the spec-to-code pipeline as observed, worktree and test-process hygiene, and two enforced rules (wiki pages only through wiki_write, worktrees inside the repo), plus /wiki to compile a page with TikZ to PDF.

surface.title: Terminal surface
surface.description: ink: lifted status tones for a dark terminal. paper: deep status inks for a light terminal (the design system's data-surface).

cortex_server.title: Cortex MCP server name
cortex_server.description: The server name as /mcp lists it, or its tool-name spelling (plugin_hypermnesia-mcp_cortex).

hygiene_script.title: disk_hygiene.py path
hygiene_script.description: The registered cleanup procedure (CLAUDE.md). A worktree created with git worktree add is registered through it; empty disables the registration.

policy_mode.title: Policy mode
policy_mode.description: observe: every effort, model and lean decision is logged in the pane and not applied. enforce: applied as logged.

quota_pressure_percent.title: Quota pressure (% of the five-hour window)
quota_pressure_percent.description: At or past this share of the five-hour window, requests run at low effort and opus/fable subagents are spawned on sonnet.

result_cap_chars.title: Tool result cap (characters)
result_cap_chars.description: A Bash, Grep, Glob, WebFetch or WebSearch result longer than this keeps its head and tail; the cut is named in the row.

classifier_model.title: Request classifier model
classifier_model.description: The model that classifies each request (task class → effort, reasoning shapes → skills) in one low-effort completion before the turn starts. An alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full id.
